response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_avg), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, o.all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.avg_humidity > o.all_equipment_avg), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_avg FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - a.all_equipment_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg, a.avg_humidity - g.above_group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN group_mean g WHERE a.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
